fixtureRequirements.description: Pinned witness.json with valid Ed25519 signature, plus a pinned trust anchor public key and a pinned 'now' timestamp

knownParityDivergences: CRITICAL: Swift verifySnapshotDetailed takes an injectable now: parameter; C# VerifySnapshotDetailed does NOT. Fixture-driven witness verify tests can be made hermetic on macOS but NOT on Windows without a code change. This is a blocking gap for deterministic fixture testing on Windows.
